# ARMenu - Augmented Reality Restaurant Menu SaaS

> Restaurant menu SaaS letting diners view dishes as 3D models in augmented reality before ordering.

Author: Muhammad Tanveer (Full-Stack AI Automation Engineer)
Contact: mtanveertahir66@gmail.com | https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-tanveer-advenno/
Repository: https://github.com/haddindeve/armenu-augmented-reality-menu-saas
Source availability: implementation held in a private repository; access on request.

## Summary
Diners order from text and photographs and are routinely surprised by portion size and presentation. Restaurants carry the cost of that mismatch in returned plates and poor reviews.

A multi-tenant SaaS where restaurants manage dishes and attach 3D models, and diners view them in augmented reality from a phone browser - no app install, since anything requiring a download will not be used at a table.

## Stack
Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Styling: Tailwind CSS, AR: Browser-based WebAR rendering, Architecture: Multi-tenant SaaS

## Capabilities
- Augmented reality dish preview
- No app install required
- Multi-tenant restaurant management
- Mobile-first diner experience

## Outcomes
- Diners see true portion and presentation before ordering
- Delivered in-browser, removing the install barrier at the table

## FAQ
Q: Do diners need an app?
A: No - AR runs in the phone's browser from a QR code or link.

Q: How do restaurants add dishes?
A: Through a management interface where each dish can carry a 3D model alongside its price and description.

Q: Is it multi-tenant?
A: Yes - each restaurant manages its own menu within one platform.

Q: Is the code available?
A: Private repository; access on request.
